create_ray_pp_communicator: create a RayPPCommunicator for pipeline parallelism in Ray Compiled Graph with actor handles and world size
build_actor_rank_mapping: build a mapping from Ray actor IDs to vLLM pipeline parallel ranks using collective all_gather
send_tensor_to_peer: send a torch.Tensor to a peer rank in the pipeline parallel group via NCCL
recv_tensor_from_peer: receive a torch.Tensor from a peer rank in the pipeline parallel group and synchronize the stream
destroy_communicator: destroy a RayPPCommunicator by closing it and releasing resources
